problems_addressed.solution_summary: Chris focused on open houses and cold calling, which accounted for 95% of his business in the first year.

problems_addressed.specific_problem: Overcoming the fear of cold calling
problems_addressed.solution_summary: Chris developed a friendly, disarming script and focused on consistency to overcome initial discomfort.

problems_addressed.specific_problem: Staying organized and focused on high-impact activities
problems_addressed.solution_summary: Chris uses a system called Activate Daily to track and execute critical tasks each day.

episode_summary: Chris Wolfe shares his journey from a failed house flipping business to becoming a top-producing real estate agent in a new market. He emphasizes the importance of open houses and cold calling for lead generation, and discusses how he uses systems like Activate Daily to manage his tasks and focus on high-impact activities. His story offers valuable insights for agents looking to build or rebuild their business in challenging markets.
